blind.description: A stylized wooden grandfather clock (longcase clock). It features an arched pediment hood topped with three brass/gold spherical finials, a circular clock face with a golden bezel and stylized clock hands, a slender waist trunk with a panelled door and knob, and a sturdy molded plinth base. Surfaces are clean, solid, and stylized with smooth wood-grain colouring and warm tones.
blind.from_above: A rectangular wooden shape with three golden spheres aligned across the top, showing the flat back and curved front molding.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly equal in height to the 5 ft 9 in figure (about 5 ft 9 in to 6 ft tall), and about one-third as wide as the figure is tall.
